candidate_workaround: Insert the exact repository root at the front of sys.path before in-process unittest discovery.
failure_signature: An in-process unittest loader outside the repository import context returns one import-failure placeholder per requested module.
recurrence_guard: Bind in-process discovery to the repository root and reject placeholder suites before execution.
rollback: Retain the zero-test failed attempt, leave the successful-pass counter at zero, and do not claim a canonical pass.
scope_boundary: Authorized scoped unittest loading only; no full repository suite.
title: Bind in-process tests to the repository root
trigger_preconditions: A phase-local validator imports repository test modules from a script subdirectory.
